meta.title: Challenges - Taqueritos
meta.description: Join our challenges and win amazing prizes. Show your skills and have fun with Taqueritos.

items.title: Extreme Flavor Challenge
items.subtitle: Do you dare with the spiciest level?
items.description: Try our spiciest Taqueritos and share your experience. The bravest participants will win exclusive products and official merchandise.

items.title: Creative Taqueritos Challenge
items.subtitle: Show your creativity
items.description: Create the best content with our products. Creative photos, videos or memes. Winners will be featured on our social media and receive special prizes.

items.title: Collector Challenge
items.subtitle: Collect and win
items.description: Gather the most different Taqueritos packages. Each unique package gives you points. Accumulate and redeem for amazing prizes!

items.title: Family Taqueritos Challenge
items.subtitle: Enjoy with family
items.description: Share family moments with Taqueritos. Post your gatherings and celebrations where Taqueritos is the star. The best stories will win unique experiences.
